import itertools, json

outputs = []
for x in itertools.product((0, 1), repeat=10):
    a = not x[3]
    b = not (x[1] and x[7])
    c = bool(x[0] ^ x[3])
    d = bool(x[1] ^ x[5])
    e = not (x[2] or x[6])
    f = bool(x[7] ^ x[8])
    g = bool(x[2] and x[5])
    h = not (x[1] and x[5])
    p = a or b
    q = c and d
    r = not (e or f)
    s = not (g and h)
    t = not (p and q)
    u = r or s
    outputs.append(int((x[1] and t) or (x[1] and u) or (t and u)))

sub = {"outputs": outputs}
check_submission(sub)
